data.name: Bat Flapper
data.detailed_description:
A 3D arcade runner where visibility is a resource.

Bat Flapper is a fast-paced 3D arcade runner where you survive by sound instead of sight. Race through dark cave tunnels as a bat, using echo location to send pulses of sonar to reveal obstacles hidden in the darkness.

Your sonar energy is always draining, and the only way to recharge it is by eating glowing bugs scattered throughout the cave. Reaching them often means leaving the safest path, forcing you to choose between playing it safe and risking the darkness, or diving into danger to keep your sonar alive.

With quick restarts, simple controls, and a score-chasing gameplay loop, Bat Flapper is all about pushing a little farther each run while mastering on simple twist: You can’t dodge what you can’t hear... or can you?

data.short_description: Fly as a bat through pitch-black caves where Echo-Location reveals danger. Eat glowing bugs to keep your passive sonar alive, dodge deadly obstacles, and chase high scores in a tense 3D arcade runner.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-4300 or better
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or better, OpenGL 3.3 compatible
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Requires updated GPU drivers with OpenGL 3.3 support.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X / Intel UHD 620 or better
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1080p / 60 FPS at default settings.
